summary: UBS Commercial Mortgage Securitization Corp. filed an 8-K for UBS Commercial Mortgage Trust 2019-C18 reporting a change of special servicer on the ILPT Industrial Portfolio Mortgage Loan, which represented about 4.0% of the trust's asset pool at the cut-off date. Effective September 21, 2026, Situs Holdings, LLC was removed and Argentic Services Company LP appointed successor special servicer under the MSC 2019-L3 pooling and servicing agreement, per Section 7.01(d). No board recommendation, price, premium, or deal terms apply. Watch for potential loan-level distress, transfer to special servicing, and any resulting CMBS credit impact.
